text:
Foxborough, Massachusetts wɔ Greater Boston metropolitan area mu, bɛyɛ 22 miles (35 km) southwest of downtown Boston na bɛyɛ 18 miles (29 km) northeast of Providence, Rhode Island. Wɔtenaa hɔ wɔ 1704 na wɔde too hɔ wɔ 1778, wɔde too Charles James Fox a ɔyɛ British Whig MP a ɔboaa Amerika colonies no din. Nneɛma a ɛma Foxborough da adi paa nneɛ yi ne Gillette Stadium, sports ne entertainment complex a, ɛne Patriot Place a ɛbɛn no, Kraft Group na ɛwɔ.

Bɔɔl amammerɛ wɔ ha yɛ kakraa bi wɔ Foxborough kuw ketewa no mu sene sɛ ɛyɛ Greater Boston metro a ɛhyɛ no ho. Boston yɛ Amerika bɔɔl kɛseɛ, na ne tenants mmienu na ɛshare stadium no: New England Patriots a ɔwɔ NFL ne New England Revolution a ɔwɔ MLS. Revolution yɛ MLS charter clubs du no mu biako, Robert Kraft na ɔde bɔɔ wɔ 1996 na wɔtoo no din sɛ region no nsesaeɛ wɔ Amerika Revolution mu.

Region no mu soccer nhini kɔ akyiri bio. Boston Oneida Football Club a wɔbɔɔ wɔ 1862 yɛ ɔman bɔɔl kuw a edi kan wɔ United States. Abakɔsɛm no kɔɔ ɛnnɛ yi mu wɔ beaeɛ a ɛdi kan no, Foxboro Stadium, a ɛtoo akansie wɔ 1994 FIFA World Cup ne 1999 Women's World Cup. Gillette Stadium nso de kaa ho, ɛtoo 2003 Women's World Cup, 2016 Copa America Centenario, ne Gold Cups pii — abakɔsɛm a ɛma New England nkyɛn yi yɛ bɔɔl beaeɛ a ɛwɔ abakɔsɛm wɔ ɔman no mu.
